startup_rule: Read PROJECT-BOOTSTRAP.md first in every new or resumed substantial project chat.

Inspect German-Flashcards-Pro/main PROJECT-BOOTSTRAP.md and PROJECT-STATE.json before runtime/import/presentation work.
For a named source/workstream, read its own CHECKPOINT.json on the branch recorded here before continuing.

authority_resolution.user_supplied_newer_artifact: May become immediate working authority when the user explicitly says it is the latest/current artifact. Continue work without waiting for GitHub sync.
authority_resolution.github: Durable checkpoint and cross-chat coordination layer, not a blocker for ordinary safe work.
authority_resolution.conflict_rule: Never silently replace newer explicit user input with older GitHub content. Record the discrepancy and work from the newer authority for the current task.
authority_resolution.persistence_rule: When GitHub is available, persist durable checkpoints at meaningful boundaries. GitHub lag must not block ordinary work, but required Git-backed PASS/FINAL claims wait for persistence.

vocabulary.note: Use source-specific workspaces/checkpoints. Do not inherit grammar state or legacy Menschen mappings implicitly.

lesen.note: Keep Lesen production/runtime artifacts separate from vocabulary and grammar authorities.

schreiben.note: May evolve independently until an explicit runtime integration checkpoint is created.

flashcards_runtime_dependency.rule: Do not cache a Flashcards version/hash/commit here as authoritative. Resolve the actual runtime from the Flashcards repository and any newer explicit user artifact only when runtime/import/presentation compatibility matters.

user_time_policy: This is a side project. Continue agentically, avoid repeated manual confirmations, and surface only material blockers or decisions that affect scope, data loss, source fidelity, architecture, or visible UX.
